quizzes.title: Module 1 Quiz: Starting Out as a Real Estate VA

questions.text: What does a Real Estate VA primarily do?
choices: Supports agents with listing coordination, data entry, marketing, and admin tasks

questions.text: Why do agents hire a Real Estate VA?
choices: They lack time for paperwork and want to focus on clients and closings
VAs are licensed to sell homes

questions.text: Which trait matters most for a Real Estate VA?
In the real estate transaction process, what happens during 'closing'?
choices: Final paperwork is signed and ownership transfers

questions.text: What's an important part of setting up a home workspace for real estate VA work?
choices: Reliable internet and organized client/listing folders

questions.text: What is the MLS?
choices: A shared database where licensed agents list homes for sale

questions.text: Under whose access does a Real Estate VA typically use the MLS?
What is a Real Estate CRM like Follow Up Boss used for?
choices: Managing leads, follow-ups, and client relationships

questions.text: What is DocuSign primarily used for?
choices: Legally signing and tracking real estate documents remotely

questions.text: Why do listings need social media and marketing beyond the MLS?
choices: Buyers browse social platforms and portals daily, so strong visuals help listings stand out
MLS listings are illegal without social posts
Marketing replaces the need for accurate data
Social media is only for luxury homes

questions.text: What is the purpose of transaction management software like Dotloop or SkySlope?
choices: Tracking documents and deadlines for a transaction in one shared place

questions.text: What should a VA do if they notice a missing document in a transaction checklist?
choices: Ignore it and hope it appears
Flag it to the agent early, before it becomes urgent

quizzes.title: Module 3 Quiz: Core Real Estate VA Skills

questions.text: What does listing coordination involve?
choices: Gathering details and entering accurate data before a listing goes live

questions.text: Why is fast lead follow-up so important in real estate?
choices: Leads go cold quickly and a competitor agent may respond first
Follow-up is optional and rarely matters

questions.text: What is transaction coordination primarily focused on?
choices: Tracking deadlines and documents once a home is under contract
Marketing homes that haven't sold yet

questions.text: What should a good listing flyer include?
choices: The strongest photo, key features, price, and agent contact info
A blank page for the buyer to fill in

questions.text: Why should a VA update a listing's status promptly (e.g., to pending or sold)?
choices: Because inaccurate live listings mislead buyers and can violate MLS rules
Status updates are optional and rarely checked
Only the agent is allowed to view listing status
Buyers do not see listing status

questions.text: What is a 'mock listing package' used for?
choices: A sample project created to demonstrate your skills without a paying client

questions.text: How should mock/practice projects be labeled in a portfolio?
choices: As real client results with no disclaimer
Clearly and honestly as sample or practice work
They should never be shown to anyone

questions.text: What should a complete sample listing package include?
choices: An MLS-style data sheet, a designed flyer, and a transaction checklist

questions.text: Which free tools work well for building a simple portfolio page?
Besides marketing, what else should a Real Estate VA portfolio demonstrate?
choices: Organizational skills, like checklists and tracking systems
Personal hobbies unrelated to the work

questions.text: What should a Real Estate VA resume bullet point focus on?
choices: Specific, quantifiable tasks like listings entered or transactions tracked
Generic job titles with no context

questions.text: What makes a strong proposal to a real estate agent?
choices: Personalization referencing the agent's actual listings or workflow
A generic copy-pasted message sent to everyone
No mention of relevant tools or skills

questions.text: Which platforms are commonly used to find Real Estate VA clients?
What is a good goal during a discovery call with a potential agent client?
choices: Understand their current workflow, tools, and expectations

questions.text: A good freelance profile headline for a Real Estate VA should be:
choices: Specific, naming your real estate skills and the value you offer

quizzes.title: Module 6 Quiz: Landing Your First Client and Beyond

questions.text: What is a good first step when onboarding a new agent client?
choices: Clarify scope, access, and the first month's plan in writing
Guess what they want without asking
Avoid all communication in week one

questions.text: Which is a common pricing model for Real Estate VA services?
choices: Charging in a currency you don't understand

questions.text: What is a practical way to manage multiple agent accounts without mixing them up?
choices: Use separate, clearly labeled files and double-check accounts before updates
Use one shared login for every agent
Enter the same data into every account

questions.text: How should a Real Estate VA respond to difficult client feedback?
choices: Listen professionally, clarify the concern, and revise where reasonable
Take it personally and stop responding
Argue that the agent is always wrong

questions.text: What helps build a long-term Real Estate VA career?
choices: Asking for testimonials and continuously learning new tools/platforms
Refusing to learn new platforms or tools

questions.text: What should always remain the licensed agent's responsibility, never the VA's?
choices: Legal, contractual, and licensed real estate decisions
Logging a lead in the CRM

questions.text: When is it appropriate to raise your rates as a Real Estate VA?
choices: As your skills and track record grow, with advance notice to existing clients
Never, rates should stay fixed forever
Only when a client asks you to raise them
Immediately upon signing any new client
